notes: U1 fast-shell reference set: minimal UP kernel with a built-in initramfs and a 16 KB re-linked stub.
The build outputs live under research/uml-fastboot/out/ (gitignored); a clean checkout validates the manifest and committed pins only.
Byte reproducibility is claimed only for two builds in the same pinned container path; cross-path and cross-toolchain equality is not claimed (U1 manifest section 5).

KBUILD_BUILD_VERSION is pinned to 1 because scripts/build-version increments the output-tree .version on every rebuild when it is unset. The recorded two-build equality deleted out/arm64-up between runs, which reset .version to 1.

toolchain.name: android-ndk
toolchain.compiler: Android (13989888, +pgo, +bolt, +lto, +mlgo, based on r563880c) clang version 21.0.0
toolchain.reproducibilityNote: Two arm64-up builds in the same pinned container path produced identical sha256 for linux-fast, linux-fast-noinitrd, stub_exe, initramfs.cpio.gz and both configs (U1 manifest section 5). Cross-path and cross-toolchain byte equality is not claimed.

obligations: Convey the complete corresponding source (kernel tree at the pinned commit, stub sources and build rules) with the binaries, or a valid written offer valid for at least three years under GPL-2.0 section 3.
Include the scripts used to control compilation and installation: defconfig/effective config, linker recipe, initramfs assembly, build scripts, toolchain pin and the exact command recorded here.
Include the pinned source (tag, commit, tarball sha256) that the binaries were actually built from; a download URL or release page is a pointer, not the conveyance.
Keep the source offer no narrower than the binary offer; when binaries are downloadable, equivalent source access from the same place is the baseline (GPL-2.0 section 3, last paragraph).
BusyBox in the initramfs is GPL-2.0 whether or not it was modified: ship its exact source, config and patches or the distro source offer; the obligation cannot be delegated to the distro.
Keep the GPL-2.0 text, copyright notices and this provenance record with every conveyed bundle.
Exact binary-hash reproduction is not a GPL requirement (GPL FAQ), but the recorded recipe and toolchain must be sufficient to rebuild the corresponding source.

This list records obligations for the research bundle; it is not a legal conclusion. The maintainer or ACR decides the distribution scope and the aggregate-vs-combined question for kernel + initramfs + rootfs.
